cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take Denise for coffee while I put up the leaving-party decorations. Don't say 'we need you out of the office.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't go until this spreadsheet balances.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've added the totals row twice. Remove the second one and tell her the figures are ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then she'll want to stay and check them herself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send her the corrected copy to read over coffee. The coffee is the invitation; the word 'distraction' must remain inside your head.

reason: Make A provide a precise spreadsheet correction and then refine the cover to use Denise checking habit rather than merely offering generic cooperation.
